candidates.title: Desktop Layer & Screen Boundary Calibration Screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated desktop display layer calibration screen right after rendering to let users test and verify pet visibility across multi-monitor setups.
candidates.why: Support emails report pets failing to appear on the desktop or apps stalling (3 emails), and the finish conversion drops to 64.8%.

new_desktop_visibility_setup.headline: Calibrate Pet Desktop Space
new_desktop_visibility_setup.body: Ensure display overlay permissions and multi-monitor coordinates are active before your pet steps onto your screen.

guard.reason: Adds a valid new desktop setup screen within onboarding while keeping all required steps.

candidates.score_note: Addresses reported multi-monitor pet visibility bugs, but inserting a new screen adds friction.

candidates.title: Companion Trait & Audio Voice Match Selector Redesign
candidates.change: Rebuild the pet selection screen into a stage layout featuring live sound previews and personality trait cards.
candidates.why: Adoption step has a high median completion time of 89s and a 60.9% conversion rate.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Interaction Playground Flow
candidates.change: Add an interactive mini-tutorial flow on the home introduction screen to practice pet voice commands, hiding gestures, and quick controls.
candidates.why: Users wrote support tickets stating it was unclear how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup (3 emails).

home_intro.headline: Try Your First Pet Commands
home_intro.body: Practice calling, hiding, and talking to your new pet right now.

home_welcome.text: Practice Voice Call, Practice Hide Shortcut, Practice Mood Reaction

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[0]': a choice_cards cannot do the home_welcome job (use ['animation', 'button', 'checklist', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'])

candidates.title: Finalize Pet Save Sign-In Placement
candidates.change: Move sign-in to the absolute end of onboarding after home_intro, framing account creation as saving your existing pet's memories.
candidates.why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after signing in; securing account creation after the pet is live prevents session confusion.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Pet to Your Account
sign_in.body: Sign in now to store your pet's personality, memories, and items permanently.

guard.reason: home_intro must come after every existing screen, sign_in included

candidates.title: Previous Pet Restore & Sync Prompt
candidates.change: Add an explicit helper prompt on the sign-in screen informing returning users that logging in restores existing pets.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Already adopted a pet before? Sign in with your original email to restore your pet instantly.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Generation Diagnostic & Display Hardware Indicator
candidates.change: Display real-time animation engine loading status and graphics shader initialization steps on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home waiting step has a long mean time of 2336s and 3 support emails reported launch issues.

waiting.headline: Preparing Desktop Animation Engine
waiting.body: Building graphics shaders, window transparency, and custom pet movement paths.

guard.reason: Updates waiting screen visuals while continuing to show that the pet is being prepared.

candidates.score_note: Real-time loading status directly addresses launch issues (3 emails) and extreme mean wait time (2336s).

candidates.title: Onboarding Path Time & Effort Transparency Copy
candidates.change: Clarify time commitments on the path choice screen (Instant Adoption vs Custom Pet Creation).
candidates.why: choose_path mean completion time is high (514s) with 76.2% conversion.

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like to Meet Your Pet?
choose_path.body: Choose Instant Adoption for a ready-to-play companion (30s) or Custom Creation to design from scratch (2 mins).

guard.reason: Adds time transparency to path choice while keeping both adoption and custom pet creation options.

candidates.score_note: Copy change clarifying path effort addresses 514s mean time at choose_path with minimal engineering cost.

candidates.title: Welcome Starter Item Adoption Reward
candidates.change: Display a founder badge reward on the adoption certificate screen upon finalizing adoption.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the biggest funnel drop with only 60.9% conversion.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Your companion is officially registered! Complete setup to unlock an exclusive Founder Pet Toy.

guard.reason: Mentions a 'Free Founder Toy' extra, violating the prohibition against mentioning free extras or gifts in onboarding copy.

candidates.title: Background Generation Desktop Audio Alert
candidates.change: Enable an optional chime and desktop notification when generation finishes while the window is minimized.
candidates.why: Home step mean time is 2336s, indicating users minimize the app and forget it is running.

waiting.hint: Feel free to minimize this app. We will chime when your pet is ready on your screen.

guard.reason: Adds an optional notification setting on the waiting screen without altering external settings.

candidates.score_note: Desktop notifications re-engage users who minimize during the long generation phase (2336s mean time).

candidates.title: Story Scroll Visual Introduction Layout
candidates.change: Switch the introductory story screen layout to a story scroll presentation showcasing interactive pet moments.
candidates.why: 76.2% conversion on path selection benefits from stronger visual immersion at the start.

story.headline: Meet Your Screen Companion
story.body: A living desktop pet that plays, listens, and brightens your workspace every day.

guard.reason: Redesigns the story screen to a scroll layout while fulfilling its job of introducing the pet.

candidates.score_note: Story scroll redesign targets choose_path dropoff, but requires substantial design/dev effort.
